purpose: Download and organize the A-class open-source repositories for a general Xiaohongshu/RedNote content factory. This config keeps repositories independent and does not merge, rewrite, or compress their internal structure.

repositories.role: Xiaohongshu platform automation: search notes, inspect note details, prepare/publish image or video notes, account/browser operations, comments/interactions, and data export. It should be used as the platform execution layer, not as the copywriter or visual designer.
Deep research workflow: scope research questions, collect evidence, build outlines, synthesize source-grounded research reports, and prepare content evidence cards before writing.

Topic, hook, commercial expression, Xiaohongshu title, and AI-trace diagnosis. It should judge whether a topic has click motivation, user benefit, save/share value, and platform fit before production.

Chinese humanization and anti-AI-tone editing: remove empty phrases, template structure, over-smooth AI writing, over-formal rhetoric, and make text sound like a concrete person in a concrete situation.
Primary Xiaohongshu image-card and carousel renderer: convert copy and structure into vertical cards, covers, social cards, HTML, and PNG outputs. It owns layout, not research or platform publishing.

Image-generation prompt library and visual-direction reference: covers, scenes, posters, infographics, illustrations, realism, atmosphere, and repeatable prompt templates. It should guide image prompts, not page layout.
General Chinese creator visual toolbox: cover images, diagrams, infographics, visual packaging, and additional reusable visual skills. It supplements the primary social-card renderer.
